27115-the-cattle-baron-s-daughter.title: The Cattle-Baron'S Daughter
27115-the-cattle-baron-s-daughter.creator: Harold Bindloss
27115-the-cattle-baron-s-daughter.description: A book by Harold Bindloss. The hot weather had come suddenly, at least a month earlier than usual, and New York lay baking under a scorching sun when Miss Hetty Torrance sat in the coolest corner of the Grand Central Depot she could find.

35492-dictionary-of-the-chinook-jargon-o.title: Dictionary Of The Chinook Jargon Or Indian Trade Language Of
35492-dictionary-of-the-chinook-jargon-o.creator: Unknown
35492-dictionary-of-the-chinook-jargon-o.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. v._   To lend; borrow. A word used toward children; a kiss; to kiss. Bloom, _n._   A broom. Mamook bloom, to sweep. A boat, as distinguished from a canoe. Bos-ton, _n._, _adj._   An American. Boston illahie, the United States. Cal-li-peen, _n._   A rifle. Ca-nim, _n._   A canoe. Canim stick, the cedar, or wood from which canoes are usually made. Chahko kloshe, to get well. Lately; just now; new. Chee nika ko, I have just arrived. Hyas chee, entirely new. Chet-lo or Jet-lo, _n._   An oyster.

37472-zanzibar-tales-told-by-natives-of-.title: Translated from the Original Swahili
37472-zanzibar-tales-told-by-natives-of-.creator: George W. Bateman
37472-zanzibar-tales-told-by-natives-of-.description: A book by George W. Bateman. But even the most successful of these hunters, by reason of having followed the few beaten paths known to their guides, never came within miles of such wonderful animals as those described by the tribesmen from the very center of the dark continent.

60280-a-london-mosaic.title: A London Mosaic
60280-a-london-mosaic.creator: Unknown
60280-a-london-mosaic.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The first thing that impresses me as I begin this short book on London is the large number of subjects of which I will say nothing. There are many reasons for this. One is that a title such as _A London Mosaic_ is as difficult to compose to as _Life_ or _Love_.

arxiv-1901-04304.title: Jet substructure measurements in pp collisions at s \sqrt{s} = 13 TeV with ALICE
arxiv-1901-04304.description: Abstract We present a variety of jet substructure measurements performed in pp collisions at s \sqrt{s} = 13 TeV with the focus on the groomed jet momentum fraction z g z_{\rm{g}} in a wide range of p T p_{\rm{T}} between 20 and 200 GeV/ c c and jet resolution 0.2 < R < 0.5 0.2<R<0.5 .

arxiv-2106-11155.title: Non-archimedean Sendov’s Conjecture
arxiv-2106-11155.creator: Daebeom Choi and Seewoo Lee
arxiv-2106-11155.description: Abstract . We prove non-archimedean analogue of Sendov’s conjecure. We also provide complete list of polynomials over an algebraically closed non-archimedean field K K that satisfy the optimal bound in the Sendov’s conjecture. 1. Introduction Sendov’s conjecture [ 2 ] can be stated as follows: Conjecture 1 (Sendov) .

arxiv-2203-01053.title: Unfreezing Social Navigation: Dynamical Systems based Compliance for Contact Control in Robot Navigation
arxiv-2203-01053.creator: Diego Paez-Granados, Vaibhav Gupta, Aude Billard
arxiv-2203-01053.description: Abstract Large efforts have focused on ensuring that the controllers for mobile service robots follow proxemics and other social rules to ensure both safe and socially acceptable distance to pedestrians. Nonetheless, involuntary contact may be unavoidable when the robot travels in crowded areas or when encountering adversarial pedestrians.

arxiv-2206-04208.title: Approximate distillation of quantum coherence
arxiv-2206-04208.creator: C. L. Liu, C. P. Sun
arxiv-2206-04208.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by C. L. Liu, C. P. Sun. Coherence distillation is a basic information-theoretic task in the resource theory of coherence. In this paper, we develop the framework of the approximate coherence distillation under strictly incoherent operations.

arxiv-2208-07207.title: Entanglement enhancement in cavity magnomechanics by an optical parametric amplifier
arxiv-2208-07207.creator: Bakht Hussain, Shahid Qamar, Muhammad Irfan
arxiv-2208-07207.description: Abstract We propose a method to enhance bipartite and tripartite entanglement in cavity magnomechanics using an optical parametric amplifier (OPA). We analyze this system and identified parametric regimes where different types of entanglement are enhanced. We show that, a proper choice of phase of the parametric amplifier leads to the enhancement of the bipartite entanglements.

arxiv-2304-13423.title: Fair Selection of Edge Nodes to Participate in Clustered Federated Multitask Learning
arxiv-2304-13423.creator: Abdullatif Albaseer, Mohamed Abdallah, Ala Al-Fuqaha, Abegaz Mohammed, Aiman Erbad, Octavia A. Dobre
arxiv-2304-13423.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Abdullatif Albaseer, Mohamed Abdallah, Ala Al-Fuqaha, Abegaz Mohammed, Aiman Erbad, Octavia A. Dobre. Clustered federated Multitask learning is introduced as an efficient technique when data is unbalanced and distributed amongst clients in a non-independent and identically distributed manner. While a similarity metric can provide client groups with specialized models according to their data distribution, this process can be time-consuming because the server needs to capture all data distribution first from all clients to perform the correct clustering.

arxiv-2305-19532.title: Axisymmetric pseudoplastic thin films in planar and spherical geometries
arxiv-2305-19532.creator: Chris Reese
arxiv-2305-19532.description: Abstract A simplified, pseudoplastic rheology characterized by constant viscosity plateaus above and below a transition strain rate is applied to axisymmetric, gravitationally driven spreading of a thin fluid film with constant volume flux source in planar and spherical geometries. The model admits analytical solutions for flow velocity and volume flux.

arxiv-2308-12640.title: Dedicated maintenance and repair shop control for spare parts networks
arxiv-2308-12640.creator: Chaaben Kouki, Melvin Drent, Collin Drent, M. Zied Babai
arxiv-2308-12640.description: Abstract We study a repairable inventory system dedicated to a single component that is critical in operating a capital good. The system consists of a stock point containing spare components, and a dedicated repair shop responsible for repairing damaged components.

arxiv-2403-10570.title: Symbiotic Game and Foundation Models for Cyber Deception Operations in Strategic Cyber Warfare
arxiv-2403-10570.creator: Tao Li and Quanyan Zhu
arxiv-2403-10570.description: Abstract We are currently facing unprecedented cyber warfare with the rapid evolution of tactics, increasing asymmetry of intelligence, and the growing accessibility of hacking tools. In this landscape, cyber deception emerges as a critical component of our defense strategy against increasingly sophisticated attacks.

arxiv-2406-15554.title: Testing particle acceleration in blazar jets with continuous high-cadence optical polarization observations
arxiv-2406-15554.creator: Ioannis Liodakis, Sebastian Kiehlmann, Alan P. Marscher, Haocheng Zhang, Dmitry Blinov, Svetlana G. Jorstad, Iván Agudo, Erika Benítez, Andrei Berdyugin, Giacomo Bonnoli, Carolina Casadio, Chien-Ting Chen, Wen-Ping Chen, Steven R. Ehlert, Juan Escudero, Tatiana S. Grishina, David Hiriart, Angela Hsu
arxiv-2406-15554.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ioannis Liodakis, Sebastian Kiehlmann, Alan P. Marscher, Haocheng Zhang, Dmitry Blinov, Svetlana G. Jorstad, Iván Agudo, Erika Benítez, Andrei Berdyugin, Giacomo Bonnoli, Carolina Casadio, Chien-Ting Chen, Wen-Ping Chen, Steven R. Ehlert, Juan Escudero, Tatiana S. Grishina, David Hiriart, Angela Hsu. Variability can be the pathway to understanding the physical processes in astrophysical jets, however, the high-cadence observations required to test particle acceleration models are still missing.

arxiv-2410-04496.title: Two-stage Design for Failure Probability Estimation with Gaussian Process Surrogates
arxiv-2410-04496.creator: Annie S. Booth, S. Ashwin Renganathan
arxiv-2410-04496.description: Abstract We tackle the problem of quantifying failure probabilities for expensive deterministic computer experiments with stochastic inputs. The computational cost of the computer simulation prohibits direct Monte Carlo (MC) and necessitates a surrogate model, turning the problem into a two-stage enterprise (surrogate training followed by probability estimation).

arxiv-2410-15285.title: Contextual Augmented Multi-Model Programming (CAMP): A Local-Cloud Copilot Solution
arxiv-2410-15285.creator: Yuchen Wang, Shangxin Guo, Chee Wei Tan
arxiv-2410-15285.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of cloud-based Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized AI-assisted programming, but their integration into local development environments faces trade-offs between performance and cost. Cloud LLMs deliver superior generative power but incur high computational costs and latency, whereas local models offer faster, context-aware retrieval but are limited in scope.

arxiv-2506-04764.title: HypeVPR: Exploring Hyperbolic Space for Perspective to Equirectangular Visual Place Recognition
arxiv-2506-04764.creator: Suhan Woo, Seongwon Lee, Jinwoo Jang, Euntai Kim
arxiv-2506-04764.description: Abstract When applying Visual Place Recognition (VPR) to real-world mobile robots and similar applications, perspective-to-equirectangular (P2E) formulation naturally emerges as a suitable approach to accommodate diverse query images captured from various viewpoints. In this paper, we introduce HypeVPR, a novel hierarchical embedding framework in hyperbolic space, designed to address the unique challenges of P2E VPR.

arxiv-2508-14965.title: You Only Pose Once: A Minimalist’s Detection Transformer for Monocular RGB Category-level 9D Multi-Object Pose Estimation
arxiv-2508-14965.creator: Hakjin Lee, Junghoon Seo, Jaehoon Sim
arxiv-2508-14965.description: Abstract Accurately recovering the full 9-DoF pose of unseen instances within specific categories from a single RGB image remains a core challenge for robotics and automation. Most existing solutions still rely on pseudo-depth, CAD models, or multi-stage cascades that separate 2D detection from pose estimation.

arxiv-2510-05029.title: Inferring the spins of merging black holes in the presence of data-quality issues
arxiv-2510-05029.creator: Rhiannon Udall, Sophie Bini, Katerina Chatziioannou, Derek Davis, Sophie Hourihane, Yannick Lecoeuche, Jess McIver, Simona Miller
arxiv-2510-05029.description: Abstract Gravitational waves from black hole binary mergers carry information about the component spins, but inference is sensitive to analysis assumptions, which may be broken by terrestrial noise transients known as glitches. Using a variety of simulated glitches and gravitational wave signals, we study the conditions under which glitches can bias spin measurements.

arxiv-2512-20848.title: Nemotron 3 Nano: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
arxiv-2512-20848.creator: NVIDIA
arxiv-2512-20848.description: Abstract Abstract. We present Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B, a Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Transformer language model. Nemotron 3 Nano was pretrained on 25 trillion text tokens, including more than 3 trillion new unique tokens over Nemotron 2, followed by supervised fine tuning and large-scale RL on diverse environments.

britannica-1911-rollock-robert.title: Rollock, Robert (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-rollock-robert.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-rollock-robert.description: Article 'Rollock, Robert' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. appointed by the Edinburgh town council sole regent of the “town’s college” (“Academia Jacobi Sexti,” afterwards the university of Edinburgh), and three years later he received from the same source the title of “principal, or first master,” and was engaged in lecturing on philosophy.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-louis-francoi.creator: Georges Goyau

pmc-10632962.title: Efficient sonochemical catalytic degradation of tetracycline using TiO2 fractured nanoshells
pmc-10632962.creator: Zhiyuan Zong, Emma Gilbert, Cherie C.Y. Wong, Lillian Usadi, Yi Qin, Yihao Huang, Jason Raymond, Nick Hankins, James Kwan
pmc-10632962.description: Highlights•TiO2 fractured nanoshells combined with cylindrically converging ultrasound waves were used for water decontamination.•Complete removal (100 %) of 5 ppm aqueous tetracycline was achieved within six minutes.•Moderate acoustic pressure amplitude (10.6 MPa, peak to peak) and low power input (21 W) exhibited optimal energy efficiency.

pmc-10672845.title: The Pleiotropic Phenotypes Caused by an hfq Null Mutation in Vibrio harveyi
pmc-10672845.creator: Yiqin Deng, Shujun Zang, Ziyang Lin, Liwen Xu, Changhong Cheng, Juan Feng
pmc-10672845.description: Hfq is a global regulator and can be involved in multiple cellular processes by assisting small regulatory RNAs (sRNAs) to target mRNAs. To gain insight into the virulence regulation of Hfq in Vibrio harveyi, the hfq null mutant, ∆hfq, was constructed in V. harveyi strain 345.

pmc-11770795.title: Prothèse totale inversée de l’épaule à glénosphère en polyéthylène: Résultats fonctionnels et taux du conflit scapulohuméral à moyen terme
pmc-11770795.creator: Hamdi Kaziz, Walid Balti
pmc-11770795.description: RESUMEIntroduction-Objectif: La prothèse inversée de l'épaule à glénosphère en polyéthylène (FP-RSA) utilise un concept de roulement inversé avec une pièce humérale métallique et une pièce glénoïdienne en polyéthylène. L'objectif de cette étude était d'évaluer les résultats à moyen terme de la FP-RSA en se focalisant sur l'incidence du conflit scapulohuméral.

pmc-12534466.title: An electric spring with an extended range of operation and current filtering capability for SEIG-based isolated system
pmc-12534466.creator: Swagat Pati, Amar Bijay Nanda, Abhijeet Choudhury, Binod Kumar Sahu
pmc-12534466.description: This work proposes an electric spring (ES) based on a back-to-back converter. The proposed electric spring is used for voltage control in a self-excited induction generator (SEIG)-based isolated system. This work focuses on extending the operating range of the ES as well as providing current filtering capabilities to the ES.

pmc-12555184.title: Mental health and psychosocial support for Ukrainian displaced people: lessons from LOOP project
pmc-12555184.creator: O Maat, E Scheres, M Dekker
pmc-12555184.description: BackgroundLoket Ontheemden Oekraïne PSH (LOOP) is a Dutch Desk for Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) for Ukrainian Displaced people. Being a cooperative of organisations funded by the Dutch ministry of Asylum and Migration, it started in 2022 as a central information and referral centre for care providers to support psychosocial support for displaced people from Ukraine.

pmc-12589417.title: Circulating endotoxin is correlated with fatty acid binding protein 2 and leukocyte nuclear factor-κB activation in menopausal women
pmc-12589417.creator: Ting-Yu Chen, Wan-Yu Huang, Ko-Hung Liu, Shankung Lin, Hung-Ming Wu
pmc-12589417.description: Circulating endotoxin is mainly derived from gut microbiome and is frequently increased after meals. However, the interplay between endotoxemia and innate immune cells in systemic inflammation remains unclear. The aim was to investigate the role of endotoxemia in systemic inflammation, focusing on the immune responses in innate immune cells. Menopausal women (n = 174) were divided into 2 groups.

pmc-12608244.title: Body Composition Analysis in Postoperative Breast Cancer Patients Undergoing Chemotherapy and Its Association with Physical Activity and Quality of Life: A Longitudinal Pilot Study
pmc-12608244.creator: Joanna Grupińska, Marika Wlazło, Mateusz Grajek, Magdalena Budzyń, Ewa Malchrowicz-Mośko, Tomasz Jurys
pmc-12608244.description: Background/Objectives: Breast cancer survivors often experience adverse body composition changes and reduced quality of life (QoL) after chemotherapy. This study aimed to assess changes in body composition in postoperative breast cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy and to examine their associations with physical activity and QoL.

pmc-12653518.title: Genetic Association of Mood Swings with Lung Function and Respiratory Diseases
pmc-12653518.creator: Yin Ku, Shasha Li, Dongsheng Wu, Nanzhi Luo, Zhipeng Gong, Binbin Hu, Kejia Zhao, Igor Elman, Anke H Maitland-van der Zee
pmc-12653518.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Observational studies have linked psychotic disorders to impaired lung function and respiratory diseases, but the potential association between mood swings—a potential predisposing factor for psychotic disorders—and lung health remains poorly understood. Methods: Using summary-level data from large-scale genome-wide association studies, we investigated the shared genetic basis and putative causal links between mood swings and lung function, asthma, and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

pmc-12984164.title: Status of the Mule Deer Population in Western Sonora, Mexico
pmc-12984164.creator: Juan Manuel Segundo-Galán, Enrique de Jesús Ruiz-Mondragón, Raul Valdez, Israel Guerrero-Cárdenas
pmc-12984164.description: Simple SummaryThe conservation status of mule deer in the state of Sonora, Mexico, remains unclear because no large-scale monitoring of the species’ population has yet been carried out. This study estimated the relative abundance and population structure of mule deer in western Sonora.

pmc-12987491.title: Longitudinal evidence of technology-enhanced, individualized neuromotor rehabilitation on autonomy, cognition, quality of life, and psychological well-being: Pilot multi-sample study
pmc-12987491.creator: Francesco Zanatta, Patrizia Steca, Cira Fundarò, Anna Giardini, Chiara Ferretti, Giovanni Arbasi, Roberta Adorni, Marco D’Addario, Antonia Pierobon, Joshua (Sung) H. You, Hiroki Annaka, Hiroki Annaka, Hiroki Annaka
pmc-12987491.description: BackgroundOver the last decades, neuromotor rehabilitation programs have integrated multidisciplinary approaches with the implementation of emerging technology (e.g., robotics and virtual reality – VR), to effectively target recovery complexity. While this strategy supported patient’s physical improvement, little evidence has been reported regarding the widespread effects on non-motor rehabilitation outcomes.

pmc-13452459.title: Integrated information theory (IIT) and the testability of the silent neuron predictions
pmc-13452459.creator: Sergio Ponce de Leon, Jeff Yoshimi
pmc-13452459.description: Integrated information theory (IIT) makes two predictions about the role of inactive neurons in consciousness. According to the silent brain (SB) prediction, rendering all active neurons inactive (“silent”) in the physical substrate of consciousness (the “main complex”) does not eliminate the presence of consciousness, because the neurons are still able to spike.

pmc-13534636.title: FUS controls muscle differentiation through phase separation-mediated recruitment of the transcription factors MEF2 and ETV5
pmc-13534636.creator: Gina Picchiarelli, Anne Wienand, Salim Megat, Saskia Hutten, Amr Aly, Marije Been, Isabelle Weber, Angela Bonanno, Nibha Mishra, Erin Sternburg, Pierre Cauchy, Stéphane Dieterle, Marica Catinozzi, Javier Lobo-Mancheno, Hannah Walgrave, Valérie Demais, Pierre Hener, Pascal Kessler, Laura Tzeplaeff, Annemarie Huebers, Dagmar Zeuschner, Angela Rosenbohm, Albert C Ludolph, Anne-Laurence Boutillier, Tobias Boeckers, Dorothee Dormann, Maria Demestre, Chantal Sellier, Clotilde Lagier-Tourenne, Erik Storkebaum, Luc Dupuis

uslaw-usc-t28-s1347.title: 28 U.S.C. § 1347 — Partition action where United States is joint tenant
uslaw-usc-t28-s1347.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s1347.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part IV (Jurisdiction And Venue); Chapter 85 (District Courts; Jurisdiction). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The district courts shall have original jurisdiction of any civil action commenced by any tenant in common or joint tenant for the partition of lands where the United States is one of the tenants in common or joint.
